goal: Bootstrap the self-hosted hybrid project-management method, built-in quality model, enterprise experience store, and approved project-local skill.
acceptance_criteria: The method covers people and feedback, value delivery, governance, quality planning, assurance, control, and improvement.
Repository instructions require proportionate self-hosting for non-trivial CGKN work.
Management workflow states remain separate from formal evidence statuses.
Validated and approved experience requires evidence and applicability boundaries.
Retrieval excludes unrelated, candidate, and retired experience.
Each applied experience can record a project and iteration usage outcome.

quality_metrics.measure: management artifacts conform to registered JSON schemas and semantic invariants
quality_metrics.target: all management, iteration, and experience artifacts validate
quality_metrics.method: jsonschema tests plus deterministic manager validation

quality_metrics.measure: CGKN uses the same method it exposes
quality_metrics.target: active project pack and iteration exist and repository instructions reference the approved skill

quality_metrics.measure: enterprise experience retrieval relevance and state safety
quality_metrics.target: only tag-relevant validated or approved items are selected within a maximum of 16
quality_metrics.method: unit tests with approved, candidate, retired, and unrelated items

prevention: Keep management support artifacts separate from formal evidence and delivery authority.
Use registered schemas and one canonical evidence-status set.
Avoid editing already-modified formal mainline files for this bootstrap increment.
assurance: Cross-review repository instructions, method documentation, schemas, skill instructions, and executable helper.
Confirm the skill preserves provider and local_packager boundaries.
control: Run jsonschema validation for all self-hosting artifacts.
Run deterministic manager and retrieval tests.
Run skill quick validation and targeted kernel/knowledge tests.
improvement: Record bootstrap limitations and use PB-003 as the next bounded integration experiment.

interface_expectations: The skill invokes the shared cgkn_project_management module through the project CLI.
The project pack references only registered quality metric IDs.
Enterprise retrieval returns bounded selected and excluded receipts.

feedback: The method is now self-hosted as support artifacts and cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.

worked: Existing knowledge and librarian boundaries supported bounded enterprise learning without a parallel context system.
Schema, semantic, CLI lifecycle, and skill validation provided quality checks inside the increment.
did_not_work: The first test pass contained two brittle assertions about field names and wording; the tests were corrected before closure.

Promoting the bootstrap experience after closure invalidated a candidate-state fixture and exposed a missing over-budget exclusion receipt; the fixture and retrieval audit were corrected before final handoff.
experiments: In PB-003, feed only the selected backlog, quality, risk, and experience projection into the existing provider librarian and measure prompt size plus first-pass acceptance.
